newsitem.title: USA: Campbell Soup to sell mail-order meals - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Campbell Soup to sell mail-order meals - NYT.

text.p: Campbell Soup Co plans to begin selling frozen food through mail-order delivery, the New York Times reported Friday.

The meals, engineered to reduce cholesterol, blood pressure and diabetes, will be shipped through United Parcel Service of America Inc in containers that keep the food frozen for 48 hours, the article said.
The meals were developed over the past five years with the cooperation of the American Heart Association and the American Diabetes Association, the Times reported.
